meta.title: Plan Ahead - Funeral Pre-Planning | Barringtons Liverpool
meta.description: Pre-plan your funeral with Barringtons. Lock in today's prices, document your wishes, and give your family peace of mind. Free consultation. Call 0151 928 1625.
meta.keywords: funeral pre-planning Liverpool, prepaid funeral plans, funeral wishes, advance funeral planning, funeral payment plans

intro.title: Plan Your Farewell, Your Way
intro.subtitle: Make financial provision for your funeral - fix our direct costs and make a contribution towards third party costs. You can also spread the cost with regular payment plans.

family.title: A Gift to Your Family
family.description: Remove the burden of difficult decisions and second-guessing. Your family can focus on remembering and grieving, not planning.

wishes.title: Your Wishes, Honoured
wishes.description: Ensure your funeral reflects your personality, beliefs, and values. From music to readings, every detail can be just as you'd like.

steps.title: Initial Conversation
steps.description: Meet with us for a relaxed, no-obligation chat about your preferences. This can be in person, over the phone, or even via video call.

steps.title: Document Your Wishes
steps.description: We'll help you think through all the details – burial or cremation, service location, music, readings, and any special requests.

steps.title: Choose Your Payment Option
steps.description: Pay in full, set up a payment plan, or simply keep your wishes on file. We offer flexible options to suit everyone.

steps.title: Peace of Mind
steps.description: Your plan details are securely stored and can be updated once it's fully paid. We'll provide documentation for you and your family.

wishes.title: Wishes Only
wishes.description: Document your preferences without financial commitment. Your wishes are kept on file for when needed.

prepaid.title: Prepaid Plan
prepaid.description: Peace of mind for you and your family.
features: Ensure your family has expert help at a difficult time.
Make financial provision for your funeral.

installment.title: Instalment Plan
installment.description: Spread the cost over time with affordable monthly payments. No credit checks required.
features: Low monthly payments over 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 years.
You can make changes to your plan once it's fully paid.

No additional cost for paying over 12 months. There's an additional cost for paying over two or more years and eligibility criteria applies. Please refer to the [Instalment Q&A](https://www.funeralplans.co.uk/media/ibhfxvog/eps_instalment_q_a_pdf_.pdf) and the [Terms and Conditions](https://www.funeralplans.co.uk/media/tk5plg5u/eps-funeral-plan-terms-and-conditions.pdf) for more information. We can provide you with a personalised quote.

items.question: Can I change my mind?
items.answer: Absolutely. Your plan can be updated once it's fully paid. There may be more to pay if you add additional services. If you choose to cancel the plan after the cancellation period you'll receive a refund of the original amount paid excluding the administration fee and any payments to insure an instalment on the plan.

items.question: What if I move away?
items.answer: You should be able to transfer your plan to another funeral director in the UK, or we can arrange services anywhere in the country. There may be additional fees to pay depending on local prices. Please refer to the [Terms and Conditions](https://www.funeralplans.co.uk/media/tk5plg5u/eps-funeral-plan-terms-and-conditions.pdf) for details or speak to us for more information.

items.question: What happens to my money?
items.answer: All prepaid funds are held in a whole of life insurance policy, completely separate from our business. The full value of your plan, excluding the administration fee and any instalment charges, is ring fenced and cannot be used for anything but your funeral when the time comes.

items.question: What's included in the price?
items.answer: Our services, care of your loved one, coffin, hearse, and administration costs are core parts of the plans. You can also add on additional options and third-party costs like crematorium fees if you choose. These costs are outside of our control. If these costs, as listed in the plan details, are not covered by the plan value at the time of need, there will be a balance to pay. Please refer to the [Terms and Conditions](https://www.funeralplans.co.uk/media/tk5plg5u/eps-funeral-plan-terms-and-conditions.pdf) for more information.

items.question: Can I plan for someone else?
items.answer: Yes. Many people arrange plans for elderly parents or relatives to ensure their wishes are met.

items.question: How do I start?
items.answer: Simply call us on 0151 928 1625 or complete our online form. There's no pressure, just a friendly chat about your options.
